senses.gloss:
हृत् a. (At the end of comp.
only) Taking away, seizing,
removing, carrying off, attracting &c.

हृत p. p. [हृ-क्त]
1 Taken or
carried away.
--2 Seized.
--3
Captivated.
--4 Accepted.
--5 Divided;
see हृ.
--तं A portion, share.
[]
--Comp.
--अधिकार a. {1} dismissed
from authority, turned out. {2}
deprived of one's due rights.
--उत्तरीय a. having the upper garments
stripped off.
--द्रव्य, --धन a. spoiled
of wealth.
--सर्वस्व a. stripped of all
one's property, utterly ruined.

हृतिः f.
1 Seizure.
--2 Robbing,
spoliation.
--3 Destruction.
